final_draft.answer: As of 16 November 2026, the IAM password policy for AWS account 111122223333 requires a minimum password length of 8 characters.
final_draft.note: This needs review before it goes out. The approved answer (answer:ed7db514-aac7-485f-aa1e-53f692bf40ae, owner security@harborlight.example, valid until 2027-11-16) says IAM users need passwords of at least 14 characters that expire after 90 days. The live check on 2026-11-16 (evidence:ae3e4e8e-0b91-44fd-8b27-1505eaa58d1f) found something different: a minimum of 8 characters and no password expiry. The draft gives the length the live check found and leaves out the approved 14-character wording because that wording is wrong now. The owner should decide whether to change the AWS password policy to 14 characters with 90-day expiry or update the approved answer. Either way, the approved answer should not go to customers until the two match.
